newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Qatar raises July crude price formula by 4 cents.
newsitem.headline: Qatar raises July crude price formula by 4 cents.

text.p: State-owned Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has raised its price formula for July-lifting Qatar Land and Qatar Marine crude oil to its Asian term customers by four cents per barrel, traders said on Tuesday.
According to the QGPC formula, July Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 34 cents per barrel, while July Qatar Marine was calculated at Oman plus one cent per barrel.
This is higher than the June Qatar Land formula which was set at Oman plus 30 cents per barrel, with June Qatar Marine set at Oman minus three cents per barrel.
But although the July Qatar crude oil price formula was higher compared to June, a reduction in the July Oman official price resulted in lower outright prices for both Qatar Land and Qatar Marine.
Oman price for July was set at $17.46, from $17.75 in June.
This means July Qatar Land outright price works out to be $17.80, lower than June's outright price of $18.05.
July Qatar Marine outright price was at $17.47, down from $17.72 in June.
